Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputEventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements InputEventListener
controller for managing game logic and coordinating between game board and UI Handles game events , score management and game state transactions * Timer management is delegated to GameTimerManager.

    • onDownEvent

      public DownData onDownEvent(MoveEvent event)
      Handles downward movement events and associated game logic.

      DownData onDownEvent(MoveEvent event) processes both automatic gravity drops and user-initiated soft drops. When movement is blocked, it handles brick placement, row clearing, and game over conditions.

      Specified by:
      onDownEvent in interface InputEventListener
      Parameters:
      event - the movement event containing source information
      Returns:
      DownData containing updated game state and clear row information
